description:
Building Operational Technology Integration Specialist  (Senior or Lead)

Company:
The Boeing Company

Boeing’s Enterprise Services Technology & Systems (ESTS) organization is currently seeking a Building Operational Technology Integration Specialist  (Senior or Lead) to join our Building Operational Technology team. This is primarily a remote position, with domestic travel to our site locations required up to 25% of the time, including but not limited to Arlington VA, Huntsville AL, Mesa AZ, North Charleston SC, Plano TX, Renton WA, Puget Sound WA, or Wichita KS. Our team is open to a broad range of experience levels including Level 4 and Level 5 Specialists to find the best fit for the position.

This position requires someone who thrives in a dynamic and fast-paced environment. You will be a key contributor to building and advancing the Operational Technology (OT) team, responsible for integrating systems, platforms, and data that support critical industrial and infrastructure systems. You will fulfill a broad range of responsibilities that are expected to change and evolve often as the Operational Technology landscape continues to develop. The ability to adapt and innovate within complex operational environments is paramount to being successful in this role.

Position Responsibilities:

- Build processes, standards, and operational frameworks from the ground up

- Assesses current Operational Technology systems for compliance with IT and OT cybersecurity standards and regulations

- Support technical troubleshooting and remediation for Building Management Systems / Building Automation Systems, including controllers, field devices, sensors, and system integrations

- Analyze and resolve Building Management System alarms, faults, and abnormal conditions; determine root cause (software, hardware, instrumentation, network) and implement corrective actions to reduce nuisance alarms and false trips

- Support alarm rationalization and tuning of fault detection and diagnostics (FDD) rules, applying the enterprise alarm and fault priority standard to improve signal quality and reduce operator workload

- Evaluate integrations between Building Management Systems and enterprise systems (Information Technology interfaces, fault management, analytic platforms, and Computerized Maintenance Management System) to ensure reliable data flow and operational visibility

- Support nationwide rollout and integration of the enterprise Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition (SCADA) platform for building and infrastructure monitoring; analyze configuration and connectivity issues and coordinate fixes with the site teams, integrators, and vendors

- Facilitate discussions and meetings to address IT compliance requirements and operational needs, to include forecasting of new systems or enhancements and upgrades of existing systems

- Troubleshoot industrial communication networks and protocols (BACnet/IP, BACnet MS/TP, Modbus TCP/RTU, Ethernet/IP) including use of network analyzers and diagnostic tools

- Assist with the development and maintenance of technical documentation, including integration specifications, as-built configurations, and site onboarding records

Basic Qualifications (Required Skills/Experience):

- Bachelor’s degree or higher

- 5+ years of experience with Operational Technology

- 5+ years of experience in Real Estate, Facilities Operations and/or Facilities Management

- Experience collecting, organizing, synthesizing, and analyzing data, then summarizing findings; developing conclusions and recommendations from appropriate data sources

- Experience developing and managing internal processes and procedures
- Domestic travel up to 25%

Preferred Qualifications (Desired Skills/Experience):

- 10+ years' related work experience or an equivalent combination of education and experience
- Experience with Operational Technology, industrial control systems, and relevant IT and OT frameworks (e.g., NIST SP 800-82, ISA/IEC 62443, ISO 27001)

- Experience in facilities Operational Technology (OT) systems, industrial control systems or facilities maintenance systems

- Experience with SCADA and HMI platforms such as ICONICS GENESIS64, Niagara Framework, or COPA-DATA zenon

- Experience with major Building Automation System vendor platforms (e.g., Johnson Controls Metasys, Siemens Desigo, Honeywell, Schneider Electric EcoStruxure)

- Experience with fault detection and diagnostics (FDD), alarm management (e.g., ANSI/ISA-18.2), or building analytics platforms

- Experience with cybersecurity principles specific to OT environments, including risk assessment and mitigation strategies

- Experience with multi-site programs and demonstrated ability to lead initiatives across geographic locations

- Experience with project management methodologies (e.g., Agile, Scrum, Waterfall) and project management tools (e.g., Wrike, Microsoft Project, Jira)

You’ll support Defence and Security domains at Boeing locations and Customer sites across the UK, including Autonomous Systems, Training and Simulation, Cyber, Space, Intelligence and Security.

title: Spacecraft Command and Data Handling (C&DH) Engineer - Millennium Space Systems
description:
Spacecraft Command and Data Handling (C&DH) Engineer - Millennium Space Systems

Company:
Millennium Space Systems

Millennium Space Systems, a part of Boeing Defense, Space and Security (BDS), is a fast, agile small satellite company focused on national security space. Our missions have direct impact to global security, like missile warning and Earth observation.

Our team is curious, bold and innovative. We take risks, innovate and explore new techniques and technologies. We influence change because we challenge the status quo. And when we watch our satellites launch, we know each one of us made it happen.

Job Summary:

As a Spacecraft Command and Data Handling (C&DH) Engineer, you will be responsible for the selection and management of electrical hardware and avionics systems critical to the operation of Millennium’s space vehicles. This role involves overseeing electrical interfaces through netlist management, driving vehicle architecture design to meet system requirements, and performing C&DH related analyses (data budget, signal integrity, vehicle I/O allocation analyses). You thrive with a high degree of autonomy and responsibility and can communicate technical concepts clearly and concisely to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

This position's internal job code is EE Sys Design Engineer. Our team is currently hiring for Levels 2-3.

Position Responsibilities:

- Develop C&DH subsystem architectures for Millennium’s space vehicle, driving system level design decisions and maintaining alignment with mission objectives and constraints

- Select avionics and onboard processing units that meet flight software (FSW) and data handling needs while balancing performance, power, mass, and cost

- Perform requirements definition and flow down, develop interface requirements, and manage verification activities

- Lead the identification and resolution of technical issues related to avionics and electrical hardware during design, integration, and testing phases

- Create and maintain detailed netlists to define the vehicle’s electrical connectivity

- Perform data budget analysis and guarantee positive margins for telemetry, command, and onboard processing streams throughout the mission lifecycle

- Conduct signal integrity (SI) studies to inform transmission line designs

- Validate C&DH architectures against program fault management requirements, incorporating redundancy, watchdogs, and error detection mechanisms

- Select and analyze oscillators and clock distribution schemes to meet timing requirements

- Perform clock drift, jitter, and accuracy analyses

- Analyze serial and analog interfaces for compatibility, signal levels, grounding, and EMI considerations

- Own vendor selection and trade study activities; produce make/buy recommendations that balance cost, schedule, technical risk, and lifecycle support

- Collaborate with Flight Software, Harness, Electrical Ground Support Equipment and other multidisciplinary subsystem teams providing C&DH expertise as needed

- Provide technical, cost, and schedule status updates to program leads and functional managers

- Present C&DH designs, trade-offs, and risk mitigations at SRR, PDR, CDR, and other customer reviews

- Other duties as assigned

- Bachelor of Science degree in Engineering (with a focus in Electrical, Mechanical or Aeronautical), Computer Science, Data Science, Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry or non-US equivalent qualifications directly related to the work statement

- 2+ years of related work experience

- Familiarity with industry standards for avionics and electrical hardware in aerospace applications

- Methodical design, testing, and troubleshooting capabilities

- Must be versatile and able to perform and manage multiple tasks concurrently
